mapper.select: SELECT AUTH_GRP.AUTH_GRP_SEQ , AUTH_GRP.AUTH_GRP_CD , AUTH_GRP.AUTH_GRP_TP , ( SELECT CD_NM FROM CMN_CD_INFO_TBL WHERE 1 = 1 AND GRP_CD = 'SYS_AUTH_GRP_001' AND CD = AUTH_GRP.AUTH_GRP_TP ) AS AUTH_GRP_TP_NM , AUTH_GRP.USE_YN , AUTH_GRP.AUTH_GRP_NM , AUTH_GRP.AUTH_GRP_DESC , TO_CHAR(AUTH_GRP.RGST_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS.MS') AS RGST_DT , AUTH_GRP.RGST_SEQ , ( SELECT ADM_NM FROM SYS_ADM_INFO_TBL WHERE 1 = 1 AND ADM_SEQ = AUTH_GRP.RGST_SEQ ) AS RGST_NM , TO_CHAR(AUTH_GRP.UPDT_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS.MS') AS UPDT_DT , AUTH_GRP.UPDT_SEQ , ( SELECT ADM_NM FROM SYS_ADM_INFO_TBL WHERE 1 = 1 AND ADM_SEQ = AUTH_GRP.UPDT_SEQ ) AS UPDT_NM FROM SYS_AUTH_GRP_INFO_TBL AUTH_GRP WHERE 1 = 1 AND (((#{useYn, jdbcType=VARCHAR} IS NULL) OR (#{useYn, jdbcType=VARCHAR} = '')) OR (AUTH_GRP.USE_YN = #{useYn, jdbcType=VARCHAR})) AND (((#{authGrpTp, jdbcType=VARCHAR} IS NULL) OR (#{authGrpTp, jdbcType=VARCHAR} = '')) OR (AUTH_GRP.AUTH_GRP_TP = #{authGrpTp, jdbcType=VARCHAR})) AND (((#{authGrpNm, jdbcType=VARCHAR} IS NULL) OR (#{authGrpNm, jdbcType=VARCHAR} = '')) OR (AUTH_GRP.AUTH_GRP_NM LIKE '%' || #{authGrpNm, jdbcType=VARCHAR} || '%')) ORDER BY AUTH_GRP.AUTH_GRP_SEQ ASC

WITH RECURSIVE TMP_MENU_TREE AS ( SELECT #{authGrpSeq, jdbcType=NUMERIC} AS AUTH_GRP_SEQ , MENU_SEQ , MENU_CD , MENU_TP , MENU_LVL , MENU_ORD , USE_YN , PRNT_MENU_SEQ , MENU_NM , MENU_EXEC_URL , ARRAY[MENU_SEQ] AS PATH FROM SYS_MENU_INFO_TBL WHERE 1 = 1 AND (((#{useYn, jdbcType=VARCHAR} IS NULL) OR (#{useYn, jdbcType=VARCHAR} = '')) OR (USE_YN = #{useYn, jdbcType=VARCHAR})) AND MENU_SEQ IN ( SELECT DISTINCT MENU_SEQ FROM SYS_AUTH_GRP_MENU_MAP WHERE 1 = 1 AND AUTH_GRP_SEQ = #{authGrpSeq, jdbcType=NUMERIC} ) UNION ALL SELECT #{authGrpSeq, jdbcType=NUMERIC} AS AUTH_GRP_SEQ , MENU.MENU_SEQ , MENU.MENU_CD , MENU.MENU_TP , MENU.MENU_LVL , MENU.MENU_ORD , MENU.USE_YN , MENU.PRNT_MENU_SEQ , MENU.MENU_NM , MENU.MENU_EXEC_URL , ARRAY[MENU.MENU_SEQ] AS PATH FROM SYS_MENU_INFO_TBL MENU INNER JOIN TMP_MENU_TREE MENU_TREE ON MENU.MENU_SEQ = MENU_TREE.PRNT_MENU_SEQ WHERE 1 = 1 AND (((#{useYn, jdbcType=VARCHAR} IS NULL) OR (#{useYn, jdbcType=VARCHAR} = '')) OR (MENU.USE_YN = #{useYn, jdbcType=VARCHAR})) AND NOT (MENU.MENU_SEQ = ANY(MENU_TREE.PATH)) ), DISTINCT_TREE_NODES AS ( SELECT AUTH_GRP_SEQ , MENU_SEQ , MENU_CD , MENU_TP , MENU_LVL , MENU_ORD , USE_YN , PRNT_MENU_SEQ , MENU_NM , MENU_EXEC_URL FROM TMP_MENU_TREE GROUP BY AUTH_GRP_SEQ, MENU_SEQ, MENU_CD, MENU_TP, MENU_LVL, MENU_ORD, USE_YN, PRNT_MENU_SEQ, MENU_NM, MENU_EXEC_URL ), ORDERED_TREE_NODE AS ( SELECT AUTH_GRP_SEQ , MENU_SEQ , MENU_CD , MENU_TP , MENU_LVL , MENU_ORD , USE_YN , PRNT_MENU_SEQ , MENU_NM , MENU_EXEC_URL , ARRAY[MENU_SEQ] AS SORT_PATH , CAST(MENU_NM AS VARCHAR(500)) AS MENU_PATH FROM DISTINCT_TREE_NODES WHERE 1 = 1 AND ( PRNT_MENU_SEQ IS NULL OR PRNT_MENU_SEQ NOT IN ( SELECT MENU_SEQ FROM DISTINCT_TREE_NODES ) ) UNION ALL SELECT ORDR_TREE.AUTH_GRP_SEQ , DSTN_TREE.MENU_SEQ , DSTN_TREE.MENU_CD , DSTN_TREE.MENU_TP , DSTN_TREE.MENU_LVL , DSTN_TREE.MENU_ORD , DSTN_TREE.USE_YN , DSTN_TREE.PRNT_MENU_SEQ , DSTN_TREE.MENU_NM , DSTN_TREE.MENU_EXEC_URL , ORDR_TREE.SORT_PATH || DSTN_TREE.MENU_SEQ AS SORT_PATH , CAST(ORDR_TREE.MENU_PATH || ' > ' || DSTN_TREE.MENU_NM AS VARCHAR(500)) AS MENU_PATH FROM DISTINCT_TREE_NODES DSTN_TREE INNER JOIN ORDERED_TREE_NODE ORDR_TREE ON DSTN_TREE.PRNT_MENU_SEQ = ORDR_TREE.MENU_SEQ ) SELECT MENU_TREE.AUTH_GRP_SEQ , MENU_TREE.MENU_SEQ , MENU_TREE.MENU_CD , MENU_TREE.MENU_TP , MENU_TREE.MENU_LVL , MENU_TREE.MENU_ORD , MENU_TREE.USE_YN , MENU_TREE.PRNT_MENU_SEQ , MENU_TREE.MENU_NM , MENU_TREE.MENU_PATH , MENU_TREE.MENU_EXEC_URL , AUTH_GRP.AUTH_GRP_CD , AUTH_GRP.AUTH_GRP_NM FROM ORDERED_TREE_NODE MENU_TREE LEFT JOIN SYS_AUTH_GRP_INFO_TBL AUTH_GRP ON MENU_TREE.AUTH_GRP_SEQ = AUTH_GRP.AUTH_GRP_SEQ AND AUTH_GRP.USE_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY MENU_TREE.SORT_PATH ASC, MENU_TREE.MENU_ORD ASC
